"""展示AI助手的能力"""

import datetime
import platform

print("=" * 50)
print("🚀 OmniAgent 能力演示")
print("=" * 50)

# 1. 系统信息
print(f"\n📋 操作系统: {platform.system()} {platform.release()}")
print(f"🐍 Python版本: {platform.python_version()}")
print(f"⏰ 当前时间: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")

# 2. 简单计算
result = sum(i**2 for i in range(1, 11))
print(f"\n🔢 1~10的平方和: {result}")

# 3. 数据处理
data = {"apple": 3, "banana": 5, "cherry": 2}
sorted_data = sorted(data.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
print(f"\n📊 水果库存(按数量排序):")
for fruit, count in sorted_data:
    print(f"   {fruit}: {count}")

print("\n✅ 演示完成！")`

**步骤65: runcode**
- 参数: `{"code": "import json\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n# 测试JSON数据处理\ntest_data = {\n    \"timestamp\": datetime.now().isoformat(),\n    \"test_type\": \"OmniAgent能力测试\",\n    \"results\": [],\n    \"summary\": {}\n}\n\n# 模拟测试结果\ntest_results = [\n    {\"category\": \"文件操作\", \"status\": \"passed\", \"detail\": \"读写复制移动删除重命名压缩解压全部成功\"},\n    {\"category\": \"系统信息\", \"status\": \"passed\", \"detail\": \"成功获取CPU/内存/磁盘/网络信息\"},\n    {\"category\": \"代码执行\", \"status\": \"passed\", \"detail\": \"Python代码执行成功\"},\n    {\"category\": \"文本搜索\", \"status\": \"passed\", \"detail\": \"grep搜索功能正常\"},\n]\n\ntest_data[\"results\"] = test_results\n\n# 计算通过率\npassed_count = sum(1 for r in test_results if r[\"status\"] == \"passed\")\ntest_data[\"summary\"][\"total_tests\"] = len(test_results)\ntest_data[\"summary\"][\"passed\"] = passed_count\ntest_data[\"summary\"][\"failed\"] = len(test_results) - passed_count\ntest_data[\"summary\"][\"pass_rate\"] = f\"{passed_count/len(test_results)*100:.1f}%\"\n\n# 输出JSON\nprint(json.dumps(test_data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))\n\n# 数学计算测试\nfibonacci = [0, 1]\nfor i in range(2, 10):\n    fibonacci.append(fibonacci[i-1] + fibonacci[i-2])\nprint(f\"\\n斐波那契数列(前10项): {fibonacci}\")\n\n# 字符串处理测试\ntest_str = \"OmniAgent全能助手能力测试2026\"\nprint(f\"\\n字符串长度: {len(test_str)}\")\nprint(f\"包含数字: {'2026' in test_str}\")\nprint(f\"反转: {test_str[::-1]}\")\n\n# 列表推导式测试\nsquares = [x**2 for x in range(1, 11)]\nprint(f\"\\n1-10的平方: {squares}\")\neven_squares = [x**2 for x in range(1, 11) if x % 2 == 0]\nprint(f\"偶数的平方: {even_squares}\")", "language": "python", "timeout": 30}`
